concept: THE GATE WITH NO NUMBER. A freeze on every new Alaska data center is drawn as a barrier gate whose sorting aperture was never cut and whose clock has no hands, so it stops everything it meets rather than discriminating, and the project it actually decides is the one at the wellhead that no other gate reaches.

treatment.judge_reasoning: Its central object IS the thesis, the two absences in that object are literally the button, and the net-new asset was already built and taste-looped this run. The alternatives either argued against the fair counterpoint the angle must honour without hedging, or drifted celebratory against a ledger already skewed that way, or needed a from-scratch hero whose payoff asserts the vacuum was imaginary.
grafts: the balance-scale money deflation, from the Comedian, carrying zero spoken dollar figures
the Anchorage conditional-test staged as a verdict you watch happen, from the Comedian
the three gates standing untouched over an empty road, from the Explainer
the engraved WHERE DOES THE POWER COME FROM board at the signature shot rather than the button, from the Enthusiast
kills: the eleven second Act 1 money block

the pen that hovers and never signs, which stages a human refusing to act and contradicts the film's own no-villain contract. Replaced with a blank statute book, because the absence is real and the villain is not.
the arrow that taps the empty slot, which re-explains what the cold open already showed
two full rigs side by side for the turn, which halves the on-screen size of the one detail the film depends on. The turn punches in on the plates and clocks only.

angle: Alaska's data-center gate isn't missing, it's gas and interconnection, and a moratorium with no size threshold binds hardest on the one project the existing gates never touch: the facility that makes its own power at the wellhead and never competes with an Alaskan household for a kilowatt hour.

open_loop.what: Two machines of visibly different size are presented to the freeze's plate and it stops BOTH identically, with the line that two numbers decide who this catches. Neither number is named until New York's rig arrives carrying both.

divergence_note: The last four dispatches were night or dusk films (07-25 tungsten night, 07-26 a flat lit interior, 07-29 filament amber on black, 07-30 an instrument-blue abyss), because NightGrade existed and had no daylight counterpart, so the engine could only really build a lit night. DayGrade was written this run and this is the first high-key daylight Dispatch in five, under a thin overcast with a findable sun. The spatial signature is new too: eye-level-immersive plus fullbleed-split plus vertical-descent has not been used in the last four, where the signatures were cross-section-cutaway over stacked-layers, macro-closeup over grid-modular, exploded-diagram over single-object-void, and eye-level-immersive over stacked-layers. The hero is a net-new conditional-gate family rather than a sensing instrument, which breaks a run of machines that listen or look. And the central metaphor was deliberately changed mid-run away from a blank gauge, because 07-30 already used a gauge with no printed scale behind its needle as its own thesis image, and a needle with nothing to point at two films running is the same picture twice even though the axes gate would have scored the rest of the fingerprint as distinct.
